content.text: GATE 2027 is organised by IIT Madras. Registration closed in October 2026 (regular window to 5 October, extended to 12 October, special window 15–16 October), and the correction window ran from 10 to 14 November 2026. The sizes below are from the GATE 2027 Information Brochure, Section 6.7, and the GATE 2027 website.

rows.text: up to 600 KB (website: at least 5 KB)

GATE also sets a pixel range and a shape: the photo must be between 200×260 and 530×690 pixels with a width:height ratio of 0.66–0.89, and the signature between 250×80 and 580×180 pixels. SahiSize locks the crop to 3.5×4.5 cm for the photo and about 3.2:1 for the signature, so both land inside the ranges.
A signature on a dark background, or in any ink other than black or dark blue
ALL CAPITALS, initials only, or a digital signature
Too small, outside the box, or not horizontal

The brochure says the face should cover 30–35% of the photograph, and the very next line says 60–70% after cropping. The GATE 2027 photograph and signature page says only 60–70%, so crop with your face filling about two-thirds of the photo.
